# Froot Framework (frootjs)

> Ultra-fast, monomorphic, multi-runtime TypeScript web framework engineered for peak V8 execution and modern developer velocity.

Froot provides high-performance HTTP routing, type-safe middleware pipelines, streaming responses (SSE & text), WebSockets, OpenAPI 3.1 documentation generation, server-rendered JSX, and WinterCG-compliant fetch dispatch across Node.js, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers.

## Official Resources
- Website: https://frootjs.netlify.app
- Full LLM Documentation: https://frootjs.netlify.app/llms-full.txt
- GitHub: https://github.com/orbitnorth/froot
- CLI Repository: https://github.com/orbitnorth/create-frootjs
- npm Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/frootjs
- CLI Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-frootjs

## Scaffolding Projects (CLI)

The official project scaffolder is \`create-frootjs\`. AI agents can scaffold complete projects non-interactively using \`-y\`:

\`\`\`bash
# Enterprise Modular API with Drizzle SQLite, Docker, Biome, and Vitest
npm create frootjs my-app -t modular --db drizzle --docker --linter biome --test vitest -y

# MVC Layered Architecture
npm create frootjs my-app -t mvc --db drizzle --linter biome --test vitest -y

# OpenAPI 3.1 REST API with interactive Scalar docs
npm create frootjs my-app -t openapi --db prisma --linter eslint --test node -y

# Real-time WebSocket pub/sub rooms
npm create frootjs my-app -t websocket --linter biome --test vitest -y

# Real-time SSE and AI token streaming
npm create frootjs my-app -t streaming --linter biome --test vitest -y

# Fullstack JSX server-side rendered application
npm create frootjs my-app -t fullstack --linter biome --test vitest -y

# Lean single-file starter
npm create frootjs my-app -t minimal --docker --test vitest -y
\`\`\`

To programmatically inspect all available options, run:
\`\`\`bash
npx create-frootjs --schema
\`\`\`

## Core API & Conventions

### 1. Minimal Application
\`\`\`ts
import { Froot } from 'frootjs';

const app = new Froot();

app.get('/', (c) => c.json({ message: 'Hello from Froot!' }));
app.get('/health', (c) => c.json({ status: 'ok', uptime: process.uptime() }));

app.listen(3000, () => {
  console.log('Server listening on http://localhost:3000');
});
\`\`\`

### 2. Context Object (\`c\`)
Every route handler receives \`(c: Context)\`:
- **Params:** \`c.req.param('id')\`
- **Query:** \`c.req.query('filter')\`
- **JSON Body:** \`await c.req.json()\`
- **Header:** \`c.req.header('authorization')\`
- **Cookie:** \`c.req.cookie('session')\`
- **Responses:**
  - \`c.json(data, status?)\`
  - \`c.text(text, status?)\`
  - \`c.html(html, status?)\`
  - \`c.redirect(url, status?)\`

### 3. Middleware Pattern
\`\`\`ts
import type { MiddlewareHandler } from 'frootjs';

export const logger: MiddlewareHandler = async (c, next) => {
  const start = performance.now();
  await next();
  const ms = (performance.now() - start).toFixed(2);
  console.log(`[${c.req.method}] ${c.req.path} - ${c.statusCode} (${ms}ms)`);
};

app.use(logger);
\`\`\`

### 4. In-Memory Testing Pattern
Froot implements standard Web \`fetch(Request)\`. Tests run in-memory with zero port collisions:
\`\`\`ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { app } from '../src/app.js';

describe('App routes', () => {
  it('returns 200 on root', async () => {
    const res = await app.fetch(new Request('http://localhost/'));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const body = await res.json();
    expect(body.message).toBeDefined();
  });
});
\`\`\`

### 5. Fullstack App Router & Tailwind CSS v4 (`froot-fullstack`)
Froot includes a high-performance Next.js alternative powered by Preact and Tailwind CSS v4:
\`\`\`ts
import { Froot } from 'frootjs';
import { createAppRouter } from 'froot-fullstack';

const app = new Froot();
const router = createAppRouter(app);

// Built-in Tailwind CSS v4 compilation & auto hot-reloading
await router.enableTailwind({
  input: './src/styles.css',
  output: './dist/styles.css',
});

// Next.js App Router-style file-based routing with Preact SSR
await router.discover('./src/app');

app.listen(3000);
\`\`\`

### 6. Critical Rules for AI Agents
1. **Never use Express patterns:** There is no \`res.send()\`, \`res.status().json()\`, or \`req.body\`.
2. **Never call \`next(err)\`:** Throw errors directly or use \`app.onError((err, c) => ...)\`.
3. **Always use \`frootjs\` and \`froot-fullstack\`:** Core framework is \`frootjs\`, fullstack engine is \`froot-fullstack\`.
4. **Scaffolding:** Always generate with \`AGENT.md\` and \`.cursorrules\` which are added by default by \`create-frootjs\`.
